name: Facet
text: Choose a **collapsible left sidebar** that collapses to a thin icon strip on hover. This keeps the main graph area uncluttered while ensuring tools remain one click away, balancing screen space with quick access. Trade-off: users must hover to see labels, but the speed gain for experts outweighs the minor delay for newcomers.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A collapsible sidebar buries updates when collapsed—users won’t see new data until they hover, breaking liveliness. A thin top strip for alerts solves visibility but risks fragmenting the interface. Settle it with a live demo: show users a sudden data change in both designs and measure how long it takes them to notice.
